title: Matowcas (Brooklyn)
summary: Matowcas is a Brooklyn-area placename and broader territory name connected with the Native sachemdom associated with what became Brooklyn.
map_geometry_source: Approximate modern Brooklyn coordinate from LatLong.net; not an exact historical Matowcas coordinate or boundary.
history_content: The name is preserved through later historical writing about Brooklyn and through broader discussions of early European names for Long Island peoples and territories. It belongs alongside existing Brooklyn and Canarsie places rather than as a replacement for those more specific places.
translation_content:
Related forms include Matowcas, Mattanwake, Meitowax, Matouwax, Matouwacs, Metoac, and Meitowacks. A fuller interpretation is deferred to the Meitowax entry, where the name is connected with shell or periwinkle country.

Why Place Names Matter

“Linguistic studies of both older and younger names also give us the opportunity to understand how and what people used to think regarding their surroundings.”

— Josefin Devine, Place names tell a story of older times (2021), Umeå University project description
whereintheworld_content: Map location note: The pin uses a modern Brooklyn coordinate for map visibility and is not an exact boundary for the historical sachemdom or later borough.
